verdict.rationale: Weave documents a dedicated OTLP ingestion endpoint that accepts OpenTelemetry-formatted trace data directly into a Weave project, explicitly designed to coexist with an existing OTel pipeline rather than replace it. Missing for 10: no evidence of a corresponding OTLP export/emit path (only import is documented), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of interoperability beyond first-party docs.
